goal: Port lexical.hammers to v3 as an OBSERVATION (not a banlist verdict). Corpus altitude. Instead of flagging every generic name (Manager/Helper/Data... — a style smell agents readily fix, cut per structural-not-style), surface only INSTITUTIONALISED hammer terms: a banlist term that is a packet-isolate (bonds with no specific concept) AND spread across >= min_spread files = systemic domain-vocabulary poverty. slop cannot prescribe the domain term -> emit evidence, not a verdict. Consumes Lexical.over(corpus).named_entities/packet_isolates/token_locations. Legacy hammers.py (DEFAULT_PROFILE banlist) as oracle for the term set.
